title: Graph Visualization Utilities
summary: This module provides tools for visualizing graph structures by generating Mermaid diagram syntax from graph definitions. It includes components for collecting graph edges and rendering them into a human-readable diagram format.

nodes.label: Collect Graph Edges
nodes.title: Collect Graph Edges
nodes.description: Analyzes graph paths to identify and gather all edges, including their source, destination, and any associated labels, preparing the data for visualization.

nodes.label: Render Mermaid Diagram
nodes.title: Mermaid Graph Renderer
nodes.description: Converts a structured representation of graph nodes and edges into a Mermaid state diagram string, supporting various node types and rendering options.

nodes.label: Graph Definition Module
nodes.title: Graph Definition Module
nodes.description: Provides the foundational classes for defining and managing graph structures, including `Graph`, `Path`, and `Node` objects.

nodes.label: Mermaid Diagram Output
nodes.title: Mermaid Diagram Syntax
nodes.description: The final textual output in Mermaid syntax, ready to be interpreted and rendered visually by a Mermaid-compatible tool or viewer.

groups.label: Graph Analysis
groups.title: Graph Structure Analysis
groups.description: This group contains components responsible for parsing and analyzing the underlying graph structure to extract relevant information for visualization.

groups.label: Diagram Generation
groups.title: Mermaid Diagram Generation
groups.description: This group includes the core component that takes processed graph data and translates it into the Mermaid diagram language.
